title: Fix deep zoom error and enable street-level zoom on community map

requirements.text: Remove the zoom ceiling in CustomMapView and useMapTiles so users can zoom in to street level (zoom level 19+) without triggering any errors. Clamp the zoom level to a safe maximum supported by the CartoDB Voyager tile provider (typically zoom 19) rather than throwing or returning null tile data.

quotes: again when i zoom in too far it says error. I want to be able to zoom in to every street just like googlemaps.

acceptanceCriteria: Zooming in to zoom level 18 or 19 on the community map displays street-level tiles without any error message or blank state.
The map never displays an error when the user scrolls the mouse wheel or taps zoom-in repeatedly beyond the previous limit.
Tiles continue to render correctly (no null reference exceptions) at maximum supported zoom level.
Zoom controls (zoomIn button and mouse wheel) respect the tile provider's maximum zoom level as the upper bound and stop incrementing beyond it gracefully.

requirements.text: Update useMapTiles to correctly compute and return valid tile URLs and pixel-conversion values for all zoom levels up to the tile provider's maximum (zoom 19 for CartoDB Voyager). Ensure no null or undefined values are returned for tile sets at high zoom levels, and add defensive guards so the hook never throws or returns malformed tile data.

quotes: again when i zoom in too far it says error

acceptanceCriteria: useMapTiles returns a valid, non-empty tile array for every zoom level from the minimum up to 19.
The lat/lng-to-pixel conversion utility returned by useMapTiles produces correct numeric values at high zoom levels.
No runtime null/undefined errors are thrown by useMapTiles at any supported zoom level.

requirements.text: Update useMapTransform (and/or useMapZoom) to set the maximum allowed zoom level to 19 to match the tile provider capability. Ensure the zoom state never exceeds this value regardless of how many times the user zooms in via mouse wheel, pinch gesture, or the zoom-in button.

quotes: I want to be able to zoom in to every street just like googlemaps

acceptanceCriteria: The maximum zoom level enforced by the zoom hooks is 19.
Continuous mouse-wheel zoom-in stops at zoom level 19 without producing any error.
The zoom-in button is disabled or visually inactive when zoom level 19 is reached.

constraints: Do not change backend data models or Motoko logic.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Use only the CartoDB Voyager tile provider already in use; do not switch to a paid or API-key-gated tile provider.
nonGoals: Adding Google Maps SDK or any paid maps API.
Adding turn-by-turn navigation or routing features.
Changing the visual design or layout of the community map page.
Adding satellite or hybrid map views.
